_comment: Convergence-threshold discovery beats for orchard_at_dusk. Mirrors amber_cipher / hollow_season schema. The easy-difficulty case fires its early beats slightly sooner than amber_cipher — the suspect web is simpler and the mechanism tokens (the moved field gate, the long-grass path, the four-pm afternoon gap) exclude Webb quickly. The case-specific buried_motive_surfaces beat fires once the motive dim crosses 0.7 and the player is past turn 22 — it represents the late-game pivot from the surface motive (motive:boundary_fraud) to the buried one (motive:1884_transaction / alderton_silence). verdict_ready waits to turn 26 because the closing arc requires either the parish-register entry or the registry-office filing.
